page.content:
Alxa Kress was a male Anomid Jedi Master who served in the High Council of the Jedi Order. He had a fondness for Rodian Theater, and even taught Mace Windu how to perform the works of Harido Kavila in the native Rodese.

page.overview:
Who is Alxa Kress?

Alxa Kress was a male Anomid Jedi Master who served in the High Council of the Jedi Order. He had a fondness for Rodian Theater, and even taught Mace Windu how to perform the works of Harido Kavila in the native Rodese.
